name: Palazzo Avino
positioning: Family-run hotel in Ravello, housed in Palazzo Sasso, a former noble residence dating back to the 12th century, set 350 meters above sea level on the Amalfi Coast
best_for: Travelers who want a historic palazzo base in Ravello with sea and mountain views
Food and wine lovers drawn to the Chef's Table, Sommelier's Table and Lobster & Martini Bar
Guests who want a hilltop stay with seasonal access to a seaside beach club

facts.text: The hotel is housed within Palazzo Sasso, a former noble residence dating back to the 12th century.
In 2013 the hotel was renamed Palazzo Avino, after its founding family.
The hotel lobby was once a chapel built in 1756 and dedicated to Maria Maddalena Penitente.
General Eisenhower planned the attack on Monte Cassino while staying at the hotel.
Sisters Mariella and Attilia Avino took over the hotel from their father, Giuseppe Avino.
The hotel is set 350 meters above sea level, with mountains on one side and the Gulf on the other.
Rossellinis is closed from November to March; during the season it serves dinner.
The Sommelier's Table is a candlelit dinner for two in a cave with a specially designed Wine Library.
The Lobster & Martini Bar serves local lobster paired with Champagne or Prosecco.
Terrazza Maraviglia is a casual spot serving small bites and fresh pasta on a terrace high above the property, with coastline views.
The full-service spa sits next to the pool in the gardens and overlooks the Mediterranean Sea.
Hotel guests get complimentary access to the beach platforms at the Clubhouse by the Sea, based on availability.

highlights.text: The four-seat Chef's Table at Rossellinis has a menu inspired by the old Neapolitan game La Tombola, where each number corresponds to a dish.
The Chef's Table ceramics were crafted by local ceramic artist Lucio Liguori from nearby Raito.
The Infinito Suite is a duplex in the Tower, with a private terrace and a private infinity pool.
The rooftop solarium has an infinity hydropool with views of the Amalfi Coast.
The Clubhouse by the Sea is in the small town of Marmorata, a 15 minute drive from Ravello, with a complimentary shuttle from the hotel.

considerations.text: The Clubhouse by the Sea is open from May 1st to October.
There is wheelchair access inside the hotel, but the outside, with its staircases, would be a challenge.
Internal rooms have a high window for natural light but no external view.
